sources.title: Stanza dependency parsing
sources.finding: The existing parser supplies UD heads and relations, including noun modifiers. In the actual cached vehicles example, Small is already amod of vehicles; the converter loses it after caching a shorter SRL argument.

sources.title: AMR annotation guidelines
sources.finding: AMR represents modifiers, shared nodes, conjunction/disjunction and negation. Actual cached BART AMRs retain small and the robot's repeated subject/object node. AMR's quantifier representation is shallow; a compiler must still define scope. No claim that AMR alone is a fully faithful FOL parser.

sources.title: Stanza coreference
sources.finding: A separate pretrained coreference component exists. We did not download or benchmark it here. Local Reflex=Yes plus grammatical attachment was sufficient for the motivating robot example; missing event structure still causes refusal.

sources.title: Logic-LM
sources.finding: An existing LLM-to-symbolic-formulation approach uses solver error messages for self-refinement. This supports the proposed bounded compiler-feedback loop; its benchmark results do not establish fidelity on our media claims.

sources.title: PICARD
sources.finding: Incremental parsing constrains generated formal syntax. Our existing JSON grammar similarly prevents some malformed outputs; syntax validity is distinct from preservation of the original claim.

scope: Focused primary-source check plus inspection of saved tool outputs. No SRL/AMR retraining or new AMR-model benchmark.
